description: This Java class defines custom exception types used within the checkout service of the application. It includes specific exceptions for validation errors and orchestration failures related to the checkout process.

classes.name: CheckoutExceptions
classes.description: A final class serving as a container for domain-specific exception classes related to checkout operations.

classes.name: CheckoutValidationException
classes.description: An exception class indicating validation errors during the checkout process.

classes.name: CheckoutOrchestrationException
classes.description: An exception class indicating failures or errors in orchestrating the checkout flow.

methods.name: CheckoutValidationException
methods.description: Constructor for creating validation exception with a message.

methods.name: CheckoutOrchestrationException
methods.description: Constructor for creating orchestration exception with a message and cause.
